scope: Refines the predecessor's QUEUE1 OptF5Different, NextButton, Stop, RecordStart and stale-delivery actions against the implemented selection queue. Does not port its priority-player abstraction.

Stop.symbol: clear; physical player teardown is external

helpers.Step: model instrumentation: event/result/step bound, no runtime transition
helpers.Next: union of mapped actions, not an additional runtime step

atomicity: One synchronous public queue call. start synchronously delivers the prior owner's stopped settlement in the conformance harness. No await or async preparation is collapsed into these actions.

actions.Next: union of Move(to) for all nine states

history.invariant: FirstAcceptedTerminalImmutable: once an accepted transition is terminal, later moves cannot replace it
history.excluded: producer route selection, persistence, failed write retries, reason/timing projection, recovery identity

excluded: Swift capture lifecycle and identity computation beyond the admission projection

bounds.operations_per_snapshot: selection, Stop command + daemon effect, F5 command + daemon effect, or external preemption followed by selection

actions.Select: real VoiceState.speakSelection completion, commands and hint
actions.Stop: VoiceState.stop emits command; independent daemon ApplyStop performs configurable clear
actions.F5: retainingReadQueueOnStop emits retaining stop; independent ApplyF5 performs configurable retention
actions.Preempt: authoritative queue clear and external speech receipt, followed by a new selection

admission.conformance: Manual check.sh gate: real Swift XCTest over all TLC decisions and four marker variants; all daemon admission decisions/post-states; native SocketServer NDJSON A/C/B replay. Not invoked by CI or pre-push.

variants.QueueAdmissionClear: pre-Q1 clear/clear, expected F-01 silent-clear violation
variants.QueueAdmissionDuplicate: pre-Q1 clear/clear, expected F-02 older-queued duplicate violation
variants.QueueAdmissionStopLeaves: expected StopClearsAll violation when daemon ignores Stop
variants.QueueAdmissionF5Clears: expected F5KeepsQueue violation when daemon clears on F5
variants.QueueAdmissionFreshClears: expected NoSilentClear violation when a fresh selection clears pending

excluded: installed app, audio and visual acceptance
admission.identity: Shared selection-identity.json: NFC, Unicode whitespace, raw fallback if marker normalization empties the identity; preserve fenced and indented code markers
